source_format: ArcGIS MapServer query; county download site marks Tax Lot shapefile as licensed (not free open download)

policy.summary: Linn’s public web MapServer serves taxlot polygons without owner/address/value fields (good for privacy). The county download page states Tax Lot data is licensed and directs users to GIS (sbarnett@co.linn.or.us) for license info. No published text found granting public redistribution or commercial derive-and-sell. Do not promote to AWS/CDN or sell derived products until Linn GIS confirms license class in writing.
policy.terms_notes: Download page quote: “Tax Lot, Aerial Photography and Address point data is licensed.” Public MapServer copyright: Linn County Assessors Office.

viewer_outline.notes: Download page: taxlot data is licensed. No grant to draw lot lines for customers in a commercial map.

workflow_clip.notes: Licensed data — confirm with Linn GIS (sbarnett@co.linn.or.us) whether server-side clip/PIP for a commercial monitoring product is allowed without customer-visible outlines.

notes: Viewer tiles exist; pipeline-gap for shards until Grant B AND license clearance.
